Historical ContextEvidence DetailReasoning Task

Push factors drove people away; pull factors attracted them to new places.Southern and Eastern European immigrants often entered through Ellis Island, while many Asian immigrants encountered Angel Island and exclusion laws on the West Coast.Explain context and evidence without drifting outside SS.912.A.3.7, SS.912.A.3.8, SS.912.G.4.2, SS.912.G.4.3.

Question: Which conclusion is best supported by the evidence detail? (Immigration, Migration, Cities, and Social Change)

generalfeedback.text: Use the stimulus, identify the evidence, explain the reasoning, and check the mapped standard before finalizing your answer.

answer.text: Southern and Eastern European immigrants often entered through Ellis Island, while many Asian immigrants encountered Angel Island and exclusion laws on the West Coast.
